# The Odds API

> The Odds API is a JSON REST API for sports betting odds: live and upcoming games, scores, events, betting markets and historical odds, from bookmakers in the US, UK, EU, Australia and other regions.

- Host: `https://api.the-odds-api.com` (IPv6: `https://ipv6-api.the-odds-api.com`)
- Authentication: every request needs an API key, passed as the `apiKey` query parameter or the `x-api-key` request header
- Get a free API key: https://the-odds-api.com/#get-access

## Docs

- [API documentation (v4)](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/): endpoints, parameters, example requests and responses, usage quota costs
- [OpenAPI spec (v4)](https://the-odds-api.com/api-reference/v4/schema.yml): machine-readable description of every endpoint, parameter and response field
- [API reference](https://the-odds-api.com/api-reference/v4/): interactive view of the OpenAPI spec
- [Code samples](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/samples.html): Python and Node.js
- [Error codes](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/api-error-codes.html)

## Reference data

- [Sports and sport keys](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/sports-apis.html)
- [Bookmakers and regions](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/bookmaker-apis.html)
- [Betting markets and market keys](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/betting-markets.html)
- [Update intervals](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/update-intervals.html)
- [Historical odds data](https://the-odds-api.com/historical-odds-data/)
- [Permitted usage](https://the-odds-api.com/terms-and-conditions.html#restrictions): restrictions on how the API and its data may be used
